BitField.description: Transmit FIFO empty. When 1, the transmit FIFO is empty. The peripheral may still be processing the last piece of data.
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO not full. When 1, the transmit FIFO is not full, so more data can be written. When 0, the transmit FIFO is full and another write would cause it to overflow.
BitField.name: TXNOTFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO not empty. When 1, the receive FIFO is not empty, so data can be read. When 0, the receive FIFO is empty.
BitField.name: RXNOTEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive FIFO full. When 1, the receive FIFO is full. Data needs to be read out to prevent the peripheral from causing an overflow.
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO current level. A 0 means the TX FIFO is currently empty, and the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 1. Other values tell how much data is actually in the TX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the TX FIFO is full, the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 0.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO current level. A 0 means the RX FIFO is currently empty, and the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 0. Other values tell how much data is actually in the RX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the RX FIFO is full, the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 1.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO trigger settings for interrupt and DMA request.
Register.name: FIFOTRIG

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMATX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: TXLVLENA

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by the TXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMARX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: RXLVLENA

Enum.description: Receive FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by the RXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger point. This field is used only when TXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the TX FIFO becomes empty. 1 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to one entry. 15 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to 15 entries (is no longer full).
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger point. The RX FIFO level is checked when a new piece of data is received. This field is used only when RXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty). 1 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received two entries. 15 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable set (enable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENSET

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a transmit error occurs, based on the TXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: TXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a transmit error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a transmit error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a receive error occurs, based on the RXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: RXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a receive error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a receive error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the transmit FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: TXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the TX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If TXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the TX FIFO level decreases to the level specified by TXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the receive FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the RX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If RXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the when the RX FIFO level increases to the level specified by RXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable clear (disable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENCLR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXERR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXERR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

BitField.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.
BitField.name: RXDATA

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERR

BitField.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISE

Register.description: FIFO data read with no FIFO pop.
Register.name: FIFORDNOPOP

BitField.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.
BitField.name: RXDATA

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERR

BitField.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISE

BitField.description: the fifo size is equal to the template parameter "fifo".
BitField.name: FIFOSIZE

BitField.description: Aperture: encoded as (aperture size/4K) -1, so 0x00 means a 4K aperture.
BitField.name: APERTURE

BitField.description: Module identifier for the selected function.
BitField.name: ID

Register.description: USART Configuration register. Basic USART configuration settings that typically are not changed during operation.
Register.name: CFG

Enum.description: Disabled. The USART is disabled and the internal state machine and counters are reset. While Enable = 0, all USART interrupts and DMA transfers are disabled. When Enable is set again, CFG and most other control bits remain unchanged. When re-enabled, the USART will immediately be ready to transmit because the transmitter has been reset and is therefore available.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. The USART is enabled for operation.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Selects the data size for the USART.
BitField.name: DATALEN

Enum.description: 9 bit data length. The 9th bit is commonly used for addressing in multidrop mode. See the ADDRDET bit in the CTL register.
Enum.name: BIT_9

BitField.description: Selects what type of parity is used by the USART.
BitField.name: PARITYSEL

Enum.description: Even parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is even, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be even.
Enum.name: EVEN_PARITY

Enum.description: Odd parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is odd, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be odd.
Enum.name: ODD_PARITY

BitField.description: Number of stop bits appended to transmitted data. Only a single stop bit is required for received data.
BitField.name: STOPLEN

Enum.description: 2 stop bits. This setting should only be used for asynchronous communication.
Enum.name: BITS_2

BitField.description: Selects standard or 32 kHz clocking mode.
BitField.name: MODE32K

Enum.description: Enabled. USART uses the 32 kHz clock from the RTC oscillator as the clock source to the BRG, and uses a special bit clocking scheme.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. Break detect and generate is configured for normal operation.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. Break detect and generate is configured for LIN bus operation.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: CTS Enable. Determines whether CTS is used for flow control. CTS can be from the input pin, or from the USART's own RTS if loopback mode is enabled.
BitField.name: CTSEN

Enum.description: No flow control. The transmitter does not receive any automatic flow control signal.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Flow control enabled. The transmitter uses the CTS input (or RTS output in loopback mode) for flow control purposes.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Selects the clock polarity and sampling edge of received data in synchronous mode.
BitField.name: CLKPOL

Enum.description: Falling edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the falling edge of SCLK.
Enum.name: FALLING_EDGE

Enum.description: Rising edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the rising edge of SCLK.
Enum.name: RISING_EDGE

Enum.description: Slave. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a slave.
Enum.name: SLAVE

Enum.description: Master. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a master.
Enum.name: MASTER

Enum.description: Loopback mode. This provides a mechanism to perform diagnostic loopback testing for USART data. Serial data from the transmitter (Un_TXD) is connected internally to serial input of the receive (Un_RXD). Un_TXD and Un_RTS activity will also appear on external pins if these functions are configured to appear on device pins. The receiver RTS signal is also looped back to CTS and performs flow control if enabled by CTSEN.
Enum.name: LOOPBACK

BitField.description: Output Enable Turnaround time enable for RS-485 operation.
BitField.name: OETA

Enum.description: Disabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal deasserted at the end of the last stop bit of a transmission.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal remains asserted for one character time after the end of the last stop bit of a transmission. OE will also remain asserted if another transmit begins before it is deasserted.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by software. This provides the possibility of versatile addressing (e.g. respond to more than one address).
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by hardware, using the value in the ADDR register as the address to match.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Standard. The RTS signal is used as the standard flow control function.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: RS-485. The RTS signal configured to provide an output enable signal to control an RS-485 transceiver.
Enum.name: RS_485

Enum.description: Low. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active low.
Enum.name: LOW

Enum.description: High. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active high.
Enum.name: HIGH

Enum.description: Standard. The RX signal is used as it arrives from the pin. This means that the RX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: Inverted. The RX signal is inverted before being used by the USART. This means that the RX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.
Enum.name: INVERTED

Enum.description: Standard. The TX signal is sent out without change. This means that the TX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: Inverted. The TX signal is inverted by the USART before being sent out. This means that the TX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.
Enum.name: INVERTED

Register.description: USART Control register. USART control settings that are more likely to change during operation.
Register.name: CTL

Enum.description: Continuous break. Continuous break is sent immediately when this bit is set, and remains until this bit is cleared. A break may be sent without danger of corrupting any currently transmitting character if the transmitter is first disabled (TXDIS in CTL is set) and then waiting for the transmitter to be disabled (TXDISINT in STAT = 1) before writing 1 to TXBRKEN.
Enum.name: CONTINOUS

Enum.description: Disabled. The USART presents all incoming data.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. The USART receiver ignores incoming data that does not have the most significant bit of the data (typically the 9th bit) = 1. When the data MSB bit = 1, the receiver treats the incoming data normally, generating a received data interrupt. Software can then check the data to see if this is an address that should be handled. If it is, the ADDRDET bit is cleared by software and further incoming data is handled normally.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Not disabled. USART transmitter is not disabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. USART transmitter is disabled after any character currently being transmitted is complete. This feature can be used to facilitate software flow control.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: Continuous Clock generation. By default, SCLK is only output while data is being transmitted in synchronous mode.
BitField.name: CC

Enum.description: Clock on character. In synchronous mode, SCLK cycles only when characters are being sent on Un_TXD or to complete a character that is being received.
Enum.name: CLOCK_ON_CHARACTER

Enum.description: Continuous clock. SCLK runs continuously in synchronous mode, allowing characters to be received on Un_RxD independently from transmission on Un_TXD).
Enum.name: CONTINOUS_CLOCK

Enum.description: No effect. No effect on the CC bit.
Enum.name: NO_EFFECT

Enum.description: Auto-clear. The CC bit is automatically cleared when a complete character has been received. This bit is cleared at the same time.
Enum.name: AUTO_CLEAR

Enum.description: Disabled. USART is in normal operating mode.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. USART is in autobaud mode. This bit should only be set when the USART receiver is idle. The first start bit of RX is measured and used the update the BRG register to match the received data rate. AUTOBAUD is cleared once this process is complete, or if there is an AERR.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Register.description: USART Status register. The complete status value can be read here. Writing ones clears some bits in the register. Some bits can be cleared by writing a 1 to them.
Register.name: STAT

BitField.description: Receiver Idle. When 0, indicates that the receiver is currently in the process of receiving data. When 1, indicates that the receiver is not currently in the process of receiving data.
BitField.name: RXIDLE

BitField.description: Transmitter Idle. When 0, indicates that the transmitter is currently in the process of sending data.When 1, indicate that the transmitter is not currently in the process of sending data.
BitField.name: TXIDLE

BitField.description: This bit reflects the current state of the CTS signal, regardless of the setting of the CTSEN bit in the CFG register. This will be the value of the CTS input pin unless loopback mode is enabled.
BitField.name: CTS

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state is detected for the CTS flag above. This bit is cleared by software.
BitField.name: DELTACTS

BitField.description: Transmitter Disabled Status flag. When 1, this bit indicates that the USART transmitter is fully idle after being disabled via the TXDIS bit in the CFG register (TXDIS = 1).
BitField.name: TXDISSTAT

BitField.description: Received Break. This bit reflects the current state of the receiver break detection logic. It is set when the Un_RXD pin remains low for 16 bit times. Note that FRAMERRINT will also be set when this condition occurs because the stop bit(s) for the character would be missing. RXBRK is cleared when the Un_RXD pin goes high.
BitField.name: RXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs. Cleared by software.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input. Its purpose is primarily to allow wake-up from Deep-sleep or Power-down mode immediately when a start is detected. Cleared by software.
BitField.name: START

BitField.description: Framing Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a character is received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERRINT

BitField.description: Parity Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERRINT

BitField.description: Received Noise interrupt flag. Three samples of received data are taken in order to determine the value of each received data bit, except in synchronous mode. This acts as a noise filter if one sample disagrees. This flag is set when a received data bit contains one disagreeing sample. This could indicate line noise, a baud rate or character format mismatch, or loss of synchronization during data reception.
BitField.name: RXNOISEINT

BitField.description: Auto baud Error. An auto baud error can occur if the BRG counts to its limit before the end of the start bit that is being measured, essentially an auto baud time-out.
BitField.name: ABERR

Register.description: Interrupt Enable read and Set register for USART (not FIFO) status. Contains individual interrupt enable bits for each potential USART interrupt. A complete value may be read from this register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes that bit to be set.
Register.name: INTENSET

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter becomes idle (TXIDLE = 1).
BitField.name: TXIDLEEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when there is a change in the state of the CTS input.
BitField.name: DELTACTSEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter is fully disabled as indicated by the TXDISINT flag in STAT. See description of the TXDISINT bit for details.
BitField.name: TXDISEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a change of state has occurred in the detection of a received break condition (break condition asserted or deasserted).
BitField.name: DELTARXBRKEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a received start bit has been detected.
BitField.name: STARTEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a framing error has been detected.
BitField.name: FRAMERREN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a parity error has been detected.
BitField.name: PARITYERREN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when noise is detected. See description of the RXNOISEINT bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISEEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when an auto baud error occurs.
BitField.name: ABERREN

Register.description: Interrupt Enable Clear register. Allows clearing any combination of bits in the INTENSET register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes the corresponding bit to be cleared.
Register.name: INTENCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXIDLECLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: DELTACTSCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXDISCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRKCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: STARTCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: FRAMERRCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: PARITYERRCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXNOISECLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: ABERRCLR

Register.description: Baud Rate Generator register. 16-bit integer baud rate divisor value.
Register.name: BRG

BitField.description: This value is used to divide the USART input clock to determine the baud rate, based on the input clock from the FRG. 0 = FCLK is used directly by the USART function. 1 = FCLK is divided by 2 before use by the USART function. 2 = FCLK is divided by 3 before use by the USART function. 0xFFFF = FCLK is divided by 65,536 before use by the USART function.
BitField.name: BRGVAL

Register.description: Interrupt status register. Reflects interrupts that are currently enabled.
Register.name: INTSTAT

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of the CTS input is detected.
BitField.name: DELTACTS

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input.
BitField.name: START

Register.description: Oversample selection register for asynchronous communication.
Register.name: OSR

BitField.description: Oversample Selection Value. 0 to 3 = not supported 0x4 = 5 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0x5 = 6 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0xF= 16 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit.
BitField.name: OSRVAL

Register.description: Address register for automatic address matching.
Register.name: ADDR

BitField.description: 8-bit address used with automatic address matching. Used when address detection is enabled (ADDRDET in CTL = 1) and automatic address matching is enabled (AUTOADDR in CFG = 1).
BitField.name: ADDRESS

Enum.description: The transmit FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: The receive FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: FIFO size configuration. This is a read-only field. 0x0 = FIFO is configured as 16 entries of 8 bits. 0x1, 0x2, 0x3 = not applicable to USART.
BitField.name: SIZE

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the transmit function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the transmit function if the FIFO is not full. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the receive function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the receive function if the FIFO is not empty. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for transmit FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKETX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by TXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the TXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for receive FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKERX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by RXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the RXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Empty command for the transmit FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the TX FIFO is emptied.
BitField.name: EMPTYTX

BitField.description: Empty command for the receive FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the RX FIFO is emptied.
BitField.name: EMPTYRX

BitField.description: TX FIFO error. Will be set if a transmit FIFO error occurs. This could be an overflow caused by pushing data into a full FIFO, or by an underflow if the FIFO is empty when data is needed. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: TXERR

BitField.description: RX FIFO error. Will be set if a receive FIFO overflow occurs, caused by software or DMA not emptying the FIFO fast enough. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: RXERR

BitField.description: Peripheral interrupt. When 1, this indicates that the peripheral function has asserted an interrupt. The details can be found by reading the peripheral's STAT register.
BitField.name: PERINT

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO empty. When 1, the transmit FIFO is empty. The peripheral may still be processing the last piece of data.
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO not full. When 1, the transmit FIFO is not full, so more data can be written. When 0, the transmit FIFO is full and another write would cause it to overflow.
BitField.name: TXNOTFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO not empty. When 1, the receive FIFO is not empty, so data can be read. When 0, the receive FIFO is empty.
BitField.name: RXNOTEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive FIFO full. When 1, the receive FIFO is full. Data needs to be read out to prevent the peripheral from causing an overflow.
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO current level. A 0 means the TX FIFO is currently empty, and the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 1. Other values tell how much data is actually in the TX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the TX FIFO is full, the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 0.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO current level. A 0 means the RX FIFO is currently empty, and the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 0. Other values tell how much data is actually in the RX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the RX FIFO is full, the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 1.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO trigger settings for interrupt and DMA request.
Register.name: FIFOTRIG

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMATX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: TXLVLENA

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by the TXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMARX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: RXLVLENA

Enum.description: Receive FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by the RXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger point. This field is used only when TXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the TX FIFO becomes empty. 1 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to one entry. 15 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to 15 entries (is no longer full).
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger point. The RX FIFO level is checked when a new piece of data is received. This field is used only when RXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty). 1 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received two entries. 15 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable set (enable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENSET

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a transmit error occurs, based on the TXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: TXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a transmit error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a transmit error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a receive error occurs, based on the RXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: RXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a receive error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a receive error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the transmit FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: TXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the TX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If TXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the TX FIFO level decreases to the level specified by TXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the receive FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the RX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If RXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the when the RX FIFO level increases to the level specified by RXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable clear (disable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENCLR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXERR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXERR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

BitField.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.
BitField.name: RXDATA

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERR

BitField.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISE

Register.description: FIFO data read with no FIFO pop.
Register.name: FIFORDNOPOP

BitField.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.
BitField.name: RXDATA

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERR

BitField.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISE

BitField.description: the fifo size is equal to the template parameter "fifo".
BitField.name: FIFOSIZE

BitField.description: Aperture: encoded as (aperture size/4K) -1, so 0x00 means a 4K aperture.
BitField.name: APERTURE

BitField.description: Module identifier for the selected function.
BitField.name: ID

Register.description: USART Configuration register. Basic USART configuration settings that typically are not changed during operation.
Register.name: CFG

Enum.description: Disabled. The USART is disabled and the internal state machine and counters are reset. While Enable = 0, all USART interrupts and DMA transfers are disabled. When Enable is set again, CFG and most other control bits remain unchanged. When re-enabled, the USART will immediately be ready to transmit because the transmitter has been reset and is therefore available.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. The USART is enabled for operation.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Selects the data size for the USART.
BitField.name: DATALEN

Enum.description: 9 bit data length. The 9th bit is commonly used for addressing in multidrop mode. See the ADDRDET bit in the CTL register.
Enum.name: BIT_9

BitField.description: Selects what type of parity is used by the USART.
BitField.name: PARITYSEL

Enum.description: Even parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is even, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be even.
Enum.name: EVEN_PARITY

Enum.description: Odd parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is odd, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be odd.
Enum.name: ODD_PARITY

BitField.description: Number of stop bits appended to transmitted data. Only a single stop bit is required for received data.
BitField.name: STOPLEN

Enum.description: 2 stop bits. This setting should only be used for asynchronous communication.
Enum.name: BITS_2

BitField.description: Selects standard or 32 kHz clocking mode.
BitField.name: MODE32K

Enum.description: Enabled. USART uses the 32 kHz clock from the RTC oscillator as the clock source to the BRG, and uses a special bit clocking scheme.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. Break detect and generate is configured for normal operation.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. Break detect and generate is configured for LIN bus operation.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: CTS Enable. Determines whether CTS is used for flow control. CTS can be from the input pin, or from the USART's own RTS if loopback mode is enabled.
BitField.name: CTSEN

Enum.description: No flow control. The transmitter does not receive any automatic flow control signal.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Flow control enabled. The transmitter uses the CTS input (or RTS output in loopback mode) for flow control purposes.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Selects the clock polarity and sampling edge of received data in synchronous mode.
BitField.name: CLKPOL

Enum.description: Falling edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the falling edge of SCLK.
Enum.name: FALLING_EDGE

Enum.description: Rising edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the rising edge of SCLK.
Enum.name: RISING_EDGE

Enum.description: Slave. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a slave.
Enum.name: SLAVE

Enum.description: Master. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a master.
Enum.name: MASTER

Enum.description: Loopback mode. This provides a mechanism to perform diagnostic loopback testing for USART data. Serial data from the transmitter (Un_TXD) is connected internally to serial input of the receive (Un_RXD). Un_TXD and Un_RTS activity will also appear on external pins if these functions are configured to appear on device pins. The receiver RTS signal is also looped back to CTS and performs flow control if enabled by CTSEN.
Enum.name: LOOPBACK

BitField.description: Output Enable Turnaround time enable for RS-485 operation.
BitField.name: OETA

Enum.description: Disabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal deasserted at the end of the last stop bit of a transmission.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal remains asserted for one character time after the end of the last stop bit of a transmission. OE will also remain asserted if another transmit begins before it is deasserted.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by software. This provides the possibility of versatile addressing (e.g. respond to more than one address).
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by hardware, using the value in the ADDR register as the address to match.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Standard. The RTS signal is used as the standard flow control function.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: RS-485. The RTS signal configured to provide an output enable signal to control an RS-485 transceiver.
Enum.name: RS_485

Enum.description: Low. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active low.
Enum.name: LOW

Enum.description: High. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active high.
Enum.name: HIGH

Enum.description: Standard. The RX signal is used as it arrives from the pin. This means that the RX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: Inverted. The RX signal is inverted before being used by the USART. This means that the RX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.
Enum.name: INVERTED

Enum.description: Standard. The TX signal is sent out without change. This means that the TX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: Inverted. The TX signal is inverted by the USART before being sent out. This means that the TX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.
Enum.name: INVERTED

Register.description: USART Control register. USART control settings that are more likely to change during operation.
Register.name: CTL

Enum.description: Continuous break. Continuous break is sent immediately when this bit is set, and remains until this bit is cleared. A break may be sent without danger of corrupting any currently transmitting character if the transmitter is first disabled (TXDIS in CTL is set) and then waiting for the transmitter to be disabled (TXDISINT in STAT = 1) before writing 1 to TXBRKEN.
Enum.name: CONTINOUS

Enum.description: Disabled. The USART presents all incoming data.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. The USART receiver ignores incoming data that does not have the most significant bit of the data (typically the 9th bit) = 1. When the data MSB bit = 1, the receiver treats the incoming data normally, generating a received data interrupt. Software can then check the data to see if this is an address that should be handled. If it is, the ADDRDET bit is cleared by software and further incoming data is handled normally.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Not disabled. USART transmitter is not disabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. USART transmitter is disabled after any character currently being transmitted is complete. This feature can be used to facilitate software flow control.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: Continuous Clock generation. By default, SCLK is only output while data is being transmitted in synchronous mode.
BitField.name: CC

Enum.description: Clock on character. In synchronous mode, SCLK cycles only when characters are being sent on Un_TXD or to complete a character that is being received.
Enum.name: CLOCK_ON_CHARACTER

Enum.description: Continuous clock. SCLK runs continuously in synchronous mode, allowing characters to be received on Un_RxD independently from transmission on Un_TXD).
Enum.name: CONTINOUS_CLOCK

Enum.description: No effect. No effect on the CC bit.
Enum.name: NO_EFFECT

Enum.description: Auto-clear. The CC bit is automatically cleared when a complete character has been received. This bit is cleared at the same time.
Enum.name: AUTO_CLEAR

Enum.description: Disabled. USART is in normal operating mode.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. USART is in autobaud mode. This bit should only be set when the USART receiver is idle. The first start bit of RX is measured and used the update the BRG register to match the received data rate. AUTOBAUD is cleared once this process is complete, or if there is an AERR.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Register.description: USART Status register. The complete status value can be read here. Writing ones clears some bits in the register. Some bits can be cleared by writing a 1 to them.
Register.name: STAT

BitField.description: Receiver Idle. When 0, indicates that the receiver is currently in the process of receiving data. When 1, indicates that the receiver is not currently in the process of receiving data.
BitField.name: RXIDLE

BitField.description: Transmitter Idle. When 0, indicates that the transmitter is currently in the process of sending data.When 1, indicate that the transmitter is not currently in the process of sending data.
BitField.name: TXIDLE

BitField.description: This bit reflects the current state of the CTS signal, regardless of the setting of the CTSEN bit in the CFG register. This will be the value of the CTS input pin unless loopback mode is enabled.
BitField.name: CTS

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state is detected for the CTS flag above. This bit is cleared by software.
BitField.name: DELTACTS

BitField.description: Transmitter Disabled Status flag. When 1, this bit indicates that the USART transmitter is fully idle after being disabled via the TXDIS bit in the CFG register (TXDIS = 1).
BitField.name: TXDISSTAT

BitField.description: Received Break. This bit reflects the current state of the receiver break detection logic. It is set when the Un_RXD pin remains low for 16 bit times. Note that FRAMERRINT will also be set when this condition occurs because the stop bit(s) for the character would be missing. RXBRK is cleared when the Un_RXD pin goes high.
BitField.name: RXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs. Cleared by software.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input. Its purpose is primarily to allow wake-up from Deep-sleep or Power-down mode immediately when a start is detected. Cleared by software.
BitField.name: START

BitField.description: Framing Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a character is received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERRINT

BitField.description: Parity Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERRINT

BitField.description: Received Noise interrupt flag. Three samples of received data are taken in order to determine the value of each received data bit, except in synchronous mode. This acts as a noise filter if one sample disagrees. This flag is set when a received data bit contains one disagreeing sample. This could indicate line noise, a baud rate or character format mismatch, or loss of synchronization during data reception.
BitField.name: RXNOISEINT

BitField.description: Auto baud Error. An auto baud error can occur if the BRG counts to its limit before the end of the start bit that is being measured, essentially an auto baud time-out.
BitField.name: ABERR

Register.description: Interrupt Enable read and Set register for USART (not FIFO) status. Contains individual interrupt enable bits for each potential USART interrupt. A complete value may be read from this register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes that bit to be set.
Register.name: INTENSET

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter becomes idle (TXIDLE = 1).
BitField.name: TXIDLEEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when there is a change in the state of the CTS input.
BitField.name: DELTACTSEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter is fully disabled as indicated by the TXDISINT flag in STAT. See description of the TXDISINT bit for details.
BitField.name: TXDISEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a change of state has occurred in the detection of a received break condition (break condition asserted or deasserted).
BitField.name: DELTARXBRKEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a received start bit has been detected.
BitField.name: STARTEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a framing error has been detected.
BitField.name: FRAMERREN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a parity error has been detected.
BitField.name: PARITYERREN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when noise is detected. See description of the RXNOISEINT bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISEEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when an auto baud error occurs.
BitField.name: ABERREN

Register.description: Interrupt Enable Clear register. Allows clearing any combination of bits in the INTENSET register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes the corresponding bit to be cleared.
Register.name: INTENCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXIDLECLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: DELTACTSCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXDISCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRKCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: STARTCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: FRAMERRCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: PARITYERRCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXNOISECLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: ABERRCLR

Register.description: Baud Rate Generator register. 16-bit integer baud rate divisor value.
Register.name: BRG

BitField.description: This value is used to divide the USART input clock to determine the baud rate, based on the input clock from the FRG. 0 = FCLK is used directly by the USART function. 1 = FCLK is divided by 2 before use by the USART function. 2 = FCLK is divided by 3 before use by the USART function. 0xFFFF = FCLK is divided by 65,536 before use by the USART function.
BitField.name: BRGVAL

Register.description: Interrupt status register. Reflects interrupts that are currently enabled.
Register.name: INTSTAT

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of the CTS input is detected.
BitField.name: DELTACTS

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input.
BitField.name: START

Register.description: Oversample selection register for asynchronous communication.
Register.name: OSR

BitField.description: Oversample Selection Value. 0 to 3 = not supported 0x4 = 5 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0x5 = 6 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0xF= 16 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit.
BitField.name: OSRVAL

Register.description: Address register for automatic address matching.
Register.name: ADDR

BitField.description: 8-bit address used with automatic address matching. Used when address detection is enabled (ADDRDET in CTL = 1) and automatic address matching is enabled (AUTOADDR in CFG = 1).
BitField.name: ADDRESS

Enum.description: The transmit FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: The receive FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: FIFO size configuration. This is a read-only field. 0x0 = FIFO is configured as 16 entries of 8 bits. 0x1, 0x2, 0x3 = not applicable to USART.
BitField.name: SIZE

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the transmit function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the transmit function if the FIFO is not full. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the receive function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the receive function if the FIFO is not empty. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for transmit FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKETX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by TXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the TXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for receive FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKERX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by RXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the RXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Empty command for the transmit FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the TX FIFO is emptied.
BitField.name: EMPTYTX

BitField.description: Empty command for the receive FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the RX FIFO is emptied.
BitField.name: EMPTYRX

BitField.description: TX FIFO error. Will be set if a transmit FIFO error occurs. This could be an overflow caused by pushing data into a full FIFO, or by an underflow if the FIFO is empty when data is needed. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: TXERR

BitField.description: RX FIFO error. Will be set if a receive FIFO overflow occurs, caused by software or DMA not emptying the FIFO fast enough. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: RXERR

BitField.description: Peripheral interrupt. When 1, this indicates that the peripheral function has asserted an interrupt. The details can be found by reading the peripheral's STAT register.
BitField.name: PERINT

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO empty. When 1, the transmit FIFO is empty. The peripheral may still be processing the last piece of data.
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO not full. When 1, the transmit FIFO is not full, so more data can be written. When 0, the transmit FIFO is full and another write would cause it to overflow.
BitField.name: TXNOTFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO not empty. When 1, the receive FIFO is not empty, so data can be read. When 0, the receive FIFO is empty.
BitField.name: RXNOTEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive FIFO full. When 1, the receive FIFO is full. Data needs to be read out to prevent the peripheral from causing an overflow.
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO current level. A 0 means the TX FIFO is currently empty, and the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 1. Other values tell how much data is actually in the TX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the TX FIFO is full, the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 0.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO current level. A 0 means the RX FIFO is currently empty, and the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 0. Other values tell how much data is actually in the RX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the RX FIFO is full, the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 1.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO trigger settings for interrupt and DMA request.
Register.name: FIFOTRIG

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMATX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: TXLVLENA

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by the TXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMARX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: RXLVLENA

Enum.description: Receive FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by the RXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger point. This field is used only when TXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the TX FIFO becomes empty. 1 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to one entry. 15 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to 15 entries (is no longer full).
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger point. The RX FIFO level is checked when a new piece of data is received. This field is used only when RXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty). 1 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received two entries. 15 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable set (enable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENSET

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a transmit error occurs, based on the TXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: TXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a transmit error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a transmit error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a receive error occurs, based on the RXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: RXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a receive error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a receive error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the transmit FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: TXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the TX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If TXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the TX FIFO level decreases to the level specified by TXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the receive FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the RX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If RXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the when the RX FIFO level increases to the level specified by RXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable clear (disable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENCLR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXERR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXERR

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

BitField.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.
BitField.name: RXDATA

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERR

BitField.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISE

Register.description: FIFO data read with no FIFO pop.
Register.name: FIFORDNOPOP

BitField.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.
BitField.name: RXDATA

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERR

BitField.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISE

BitField.description: the fifo size is equal to the template parameter "fifo".
BitField.name: FIFOSIZE

BitField.description: Aperture: encoded as (aperture size/4K) -1, so 0x00 means a 4K aperture.
BitField.name: APERTURE

BitField.description: Module identifier for the selected function.
BitField.name: ID

Register.description: USART Configuration register. Basic USART configuration settings that typically are not changed during operation.
Register.name: CFG

Enum.description: Disabled. The USART is disabled and the internal state machine and counters are reset. While Enable = 0, all USART interrupts and DMA transfers are disabled. When Enable is set again, CFG and most other control bits remain unchanged. When re-enabled, the USART will immediately be ready to transmit because the transmitter has been reset and is therefore available.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. The USART is enabled for operation.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Selects the data size for the USART.
BitField.name: DATALEN

Enum.description: 9 bit data length. The 9th bit is commonly used for addressing in multidrop mode. See the ADDRDET bit in the CTL register.
Enum.name: BIT_9

BitField.description: Selects what type of parity is used by the USART.
BitField.name: PARITYSEL

Enum.description: Even parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is even, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be even.
Enum.name: EVEN_PARITY

Enum.description: Odd parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is odd, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be odd.
Enum.name: ODD_PARITY

BitField.description: Number of stop bits appended to transmitted data. Only a single stop bit is required for received data.
BitField.name: STOPLEN

Enum.description: 2 stop bits. This setting should only be used for asynchronous communication.
Enum.name: BITS_2

BitField.description: Selects standard or 32 kHz clocking mode.
BitField.name: MODE32K

Enum.description: Enabled. USART uses the 32 kHz clock from the RTC oscillator as the clock source to the BRG, and uses a special bit clocking scheme.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. Break detect and generate is configured for normal operation.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. Break detect and generate is configured for LIN bus operation.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: CTS Enable. Determines whether CTS is used for flow control. CTS can be from the input pin, or from the USART's own RTS if loopback mode is enabled.
BitField.name: CTSEN

Enum.description: No flow control. The transmitter does not receive any automatic flow control signal.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Flow control enabled. The transmitter uses the CTS input (or RTS output in loopback mode) for flow control purposes.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Selects the clock polarity and sampling edge of received data in synchronous mode.
BitField.name: CLKPOL

Enum.description: Falling edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the falling edge of SCLK.
Enum.name: FALLING_EDGE

Enum.description: Rising edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the rising edge of SCLK.
Enum.name: RISING_EDGE

Enum.description: Slave. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a slave.
Enum.name: SLAVE

Enum.description: Master. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a master.
Enum.name: MASTER

Enum.description: Loopback mode. This provides a mechanism to perform diagnostic loopback testing for USART data. Serial data from the transmitter (Un_TXD) is connected internally to serial input of the receive (Un_RXD). Un_TXD and Un_RTS activity will also appear on external pins if these functions are configured to appear on device pins. The receiver RTS signal is also looped back to CTS and performs flow control if enabled by CTSEN.
Enum.name: LOOPBACK

BitField.description: Output Enable Turnaround time enable for RS-485 operation.
BitField.name: OETA

Enum.description: Disabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal deasserted at the end of the last stop bit of a transmission.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal remains asserted for one character time after the end of the last stop bit of a transmission. OE will also remain asserted if another transmit begins before it is deasserted.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by software. This provides the possibility of versatile addressing (e.g. respond to more than one address).
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by hardware, using the value in the ADDR register as the address to match.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Standard. The RTS signal is used as the standard flow control function.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: RS-485. The RTS signal configured to provide an output enable signal to control an RS-485 transceiver.
Enum.name: RS_485

Enum.description: Low. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active low.
Enum.name: LOW

Enum.description: High. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active high.
Enum.name: HIGH

Enum.description: Standard. The RX signal is used as it arrives from the pin. This means that the RX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: Inverted. The RX signal is inverted before being used by the USART. This means that the RX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.
Enum.name: INVERTED

Enum.description: Standard. The TX signal is sent out without change. This means that the TX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.
Enum.name: STANDARD

Enum.description: Inverted. The TX signal is inverted by the USART before being sent out. This means that the TX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.
Enum.name: INVERTED

Register.description: USART Control register. USART control settings that are more likely to change during operation.
Register.name: CTL

Enum.description: Continuous break. Continuous break is sent immediately when this bit is set, and remains until this bit is cleared. A break may be sent without danger of corrupting any currently transmitting character if the transmitter is first disabled (TXDIS in CTL is set) and then waiting for the transmitter to be disabled (TXDISINT in STAT = 1) before writing 1 to TXBRKEN.
Enum.name: CONTINOUS

Enum.description: Disabled. The USART presents all incoming data.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. The USART receiver ignores incoming data that does not have the most significant bit of the data (typically the 9th bit) = 1. When the data MSB bit = 1, the receiver treats the incoming data normally, generating a received data interrupt. Software can then check the data to see if this is an address that should be handled. If it is, the ADDRDET bit is cleared by software and further incoming data is handled normally.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Not disabled. USART transmitter is not disabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: Disabled. USART transmitter is disabled after any character currently being transmitted is complete. This feature can be used to facilitate software flow control.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: Continuous Clock generation. By default, SCLK is only output while data is being transmitted in synchronous mode.
BitField.name: CC

Enum.description: Clock on character. In synchronous mode, SCLK cycles only when characters are being sent on Un_TXD or to complete a character that is being received.
Enum.name: CLOCK_ON_CHARACTER

Enum.description: Continuous clock. SCLK runs continuously in synchronous mode, allowing characters to be received on Un_RxD independently from transmission on Un_TXD).
Enum.name: CONTINOUS_CLOCK

Enum.description: No effect. No effect on the CC bit.
Enum.name: NO_EFFECT

Enum.description: Auto-clear. The CC bit is automatically cleared when a complete character has been received. This bit is cleared at the same time.
Enum.name: AUTO_CLEAR

Enum.description: Disabled. USART is in normal operating mode.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Enabled. USART is in autobaud mode. This bit should only be set when the USART receiver is idle. The first start bit of RX is measured and used the update the BRG register to match the received data rate. AUTOBAUD is cleared once this process is complete, or if there is an AERR.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Register.description: USART Status register. The complete status value can be read here. Writing ones clears some bits in the register. Some bits can be cleared by writing a 1 to them.
Register.name: STAT

BitField.description: Receiver Idle. When 0, indicates that the receiver is currently in the process of receiving data. When 1, indicates that the receiver is not currently in the process of receiving data.
BitField.name: RXIDLE

BitField.description: Transmitter Idle. When 0, indicates that the transmitter is currently in the process of sending data.When 1, indicate that the transmitter is not currently in the process of sending data.
BitField.name: TXIDLE

BitField.description: This bit reflects the current state of the CTS signal, regardless of the setting of the CTSEN bit in the CFG register. This will be the value of the CTS input pin unless loopback mode is enabled.
BitField.name: CTS

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state is detected for the CTS flag above. This bit is cleared by software.
BitField.name: DELTACTS

BitField.description: Transmitter Disabled Status flag. When 1, this bit indicates that the USART transmitter is fully idle after being disabled via the TXDIS bit in the CFG register (TXDIS = 1).
BitField.name: TXDISSTAT

BitField.description: Received Break. This bit reflects the current state of the receiver break detection logic. It is set when the Un_RXD pin remains low for 16 bit times. Note that FRAMERRINT will also be set when this condition occurs because the stop bit(s) for the character would be missing. RXBRK is cleared when the Un_RXD pin goes high.
BitField.name: RXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs. Cleared by software.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input. Its purpose is primarily to allow wake-up from Deep-sleep or Power-down mode immediately when a start is detected. Cleared by software.
BitField.name: START

BitField.description: Framing Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a character is received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.
BitField.name: FRAMERRINT

BitField.description: Parity Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a parity error is detected in a received character.
BitField.name: PARITYERRINT

BitField.description: Received Noise interrupt flag. Three samples of received data are taken in order to determine the value of each received data bit, except in synchronous mode. This acts as a noise filter if one sample disagrees. This flag is set when a received data bit contains one disagreeing sample. This could indicate line noise, a baud rate or character format mismatch, or loss of synchronization during data reception.
BitField.name: RXNOISEINT

BitField.description: Auto baud Error. An auto baud error can occur if the BRG counts to its limit before the end of the start bit that is being measured, essentially an auto baud time-out.
BitField.name: ABERR

Register.description: Interrupt Enable read and Set register for USART (not FIFO) status. Contains individual interrupt enable bits for each potential USART interrupt. A complete value may be read from this register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes that bit to be set.
Register.name: INTENSET

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter becomes idle (TXIDLE = 1).
BitField.name: TXIDLEEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when there is a change in the state of the CTS input.
BitField.name: DELTACTSEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter is fully disabled as indicated by the TXDISINT flag in STAT. See description of the TXDISINT bit for details.
BitField.name: TXDISEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a change of state has occurred in the detection of a received break condition (break condition asserted or deasserted).
BitField.name: DELTARXBRKEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a received start bit has been detected.
BitField.name: STARTEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a framing error has been detected.
BitField.name: FRAMERREN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a parity error has been detected.
BitField.name: PARITYERREN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when noise is detected. See description of the RXNOISEINT bit in Table 354.
BitField.name: RXNOISEEN

BitField.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when an auto baud error occurs.
BitField.name: ABERREN

Register.description: Interrupt Enable Clear register. Allows clearing any combination of bits in the INTENSET register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes the corresponding bit to be cleared.
Register.name: INTENCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXIDLECLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: DELTACTSCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: TXDISCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRKCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: STARTCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: FRAMERRCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: PARITYERRCLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: RXNOISECLR

BitField.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.
BitField.name: ABERRCLR

Register.description: Baud Rate Generator register. 16-bit integer baud rate divisor value.
Register.name: BRG

BitField.description: This value is used to divide the USART input clock to determine the baud rate, based on the input clock from the FRG. 0 = FCLK is used directly by the USART function. 1 = FCLK is divided by 2 before use by the USART function. 2 = FCLK is divided by 3 before use by the USART function. 0xFFFF = FCLK is divided by 65,536 before use by the USART function.
BitField.name: BRGVAL

Register.description: Interrupt status register. Reflects interrupts that are currently enabled.
Register.name: INTSTAT

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of the CTS input is detected.
BitField.name: DELTACTS

BitField.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs.
BitField.name: DELTARXBRK

BitField.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input.
BitField.name: START

Register.description: Oversample selection register for asynchronous communication.
Register.name: OSR

BitField.description: Oversample Selection Value. 0 to 3 = not supported 0x4 = 5 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0x5 = 6 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0xF= 16 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit.
BitField.name: OSRVAL

Register.description: Address register for automatic address matching.
Register.name: ADDR

BitField.description: 8-bit address used with automatic address matching. Used when address detection is enabled (ADDRDET in CTL = 1) and automatic address matching is enabled (AUTOADDR in CFG = 1).
BitField.name: ADDRESS

Enum.description: The transmit FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: The receive FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: FIFO size configuration. This is a read-only field. 0x0 = FIFO is configured as 16 entries of 8 bits. 0x1, 0x2, 0x3 = not applicable to USART.
BitField.name: SIZE

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the transmit function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the transmit function if the FIFO is not full. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the receive function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the receive function if the FIFO is not empty. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for transmit FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKETX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by TXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the TXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED
