BitField.description: 8-bit address used with automatic address matching. Used when address detection is enabled (ADDRDET in CTL = 1) and automatic address matching is enabled (AUTOADDR in CFG = 1).
BitField.name: ADDRESS

Enum.description: The transmit FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: The receive FIFO is not enabled.
Enum.name: DISABLED

BitField.description: FIFO size configuration. This is a read-only field. 0x0 = FIFO is configured as 16 entries of 8 bits. 0x1, 0x2, 0x3 = not applicable to USART.
BitField.name: SIZE

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the transmit function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the transmit function if the FIFO is not full. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.description: DMA is not used for the receive function.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: Trigger DMA for the receive function if the FIFO is not empty. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for transmit FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKETX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by TXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the TXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Wake-up for receive FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.
BitField.name: WAKERX

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by RXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the RXLVL interrupt is not enabled.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Empty command for the transmit FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the TX FIFO is emptied.
BitField.name: EMPTYTX

BitField.description: Empty command for the receive FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the RX FIFO is emptied.
BitField.name: EMPTYRX

BitField.description: TX FIFO error. Will be set if a transmit FIFO error occurs. This could be an overflow caused by pushing data into a full FIFO, or by an underflow if the FIFO is empty when data is needed. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: TXERR

BitField.description: RX FIFO error. Will be set if a receive FIFO overflow occurs, caused by software or DMA not emptying the FIFO fast enough. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: RXERR

BitField.description: Peripheral interrupt. When 1, this indicates that the peripheral function has asserted an interrupt. The details can be found by reading the peripheral's STAT register.
BitField.name: PERINT

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO empty. When 1, the transmit FIFO is empty. The peripheral may still be processing the last piece of data.
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO not full. When 1, the transmit FIFO is not full, so more data can be written. When 0, the transmit FIFO is full and another write would cause it to overflow.
BitField.name: TXNOTFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO not empty. When 1, the receive FIFO is not empty, so data can be read. When 0, the receive FIFO is empty.
BitField.name: RXNOTEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive FIFO full. When 1, the receive FIFO is full. Data needs to be read out to prevent the peripheral from causing an overflow.
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO current level. A 0 means the TX FIFO is currently empty, and the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 1. Other values tell how much data is actually in the TX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the TX FIFO is full, the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 0.
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO current level. A 0 means the RX FIFO is currently empty, and the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 0. Other values tell how much data is actually in the RX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the RX FIFO is full, the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 1.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO trigger settings for interrupt and DMA request.
Register.name: FIFOTRIG

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMATX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: TXLVLENA

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by the TXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMARX in FIFOCFG is set.
BitField.name: RXLVLENA

Enum.description: Receive FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An trigger will be generated if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by the RXLVL field in this register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger point. This field is used only when TXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the TX FIFO becomes empty. 1 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to one entry. 15 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to 15 entries (is no longer full).
BitField.name: TXLVL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO level trigger point. The RX FIFO level is checked when a new piece of data is received. This field is used only when RXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty). 1 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received two entries. 15 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).
BitField.name: RXLVL

Register.description: FIFO interrupt enable set (enable) and read register.
Register.name: FIFOINTENSET

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a transmit error occurs, based on the TXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: TXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a transmit error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a transmit error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a receive error occurs, based on the RXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.
BitField.name: RXERR

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated for a receive error.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: An interrupt will be generated when a receive error occurs.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the transmit FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the TX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If TXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the TX FIFO level decreases to the level specified by TXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the receive FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.
BitField.name: RXLVL

Enum.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the RX FIFO level.
Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.description: If RXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the when the RX FIFO level increases to the level specified by RXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. RegisterGroup.description: LPC_Next0 Synchronous OS/Event timer with Wakeup Timer
RegisterGroup.name: OSTIMER0

BitField.description: A read reflects the current value of the lower 32 bits of the EVTIMER. Note there is physically only one EVTimer, readable from all domains.
BitField.name: EVTIMER_COUNT_VALUE

BitField.description: A read reflects the current value of the upper 32 bits of the EVTIMER. Note there is physically only one EVTimer, readable from all domains.
BitField.name: EVTIMER_COUNT_VALUE

BitField.description: A read reflects the value of the lower 32 bits of the central EVTIMER at the time the last capture signal was generated by the CPU. A separate pair of CAPTURE registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own capture value at the same pair of addresses.
BitField.name: CAPTURE_VALUE

BitField.description: A read reflects the value of the upper 32 bits of the central EVTIMER at the time the last capture signal was generated by the CPU. A separate pair of CAPTURE registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own capture value at the same pair of addresses.
BitField.name: CAPTURE_VALUE

BitField.description: The value written to the MATCH (L/H) register pair is compared against the central EVTIMER. When a match occurs, an interrupt request is generated if enabled. A separate pair of MATCH registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own local value at the same pair of addresses.
BitField.name: MATCH_VALUE

BitField.description: The value written to the MATCH (L/H) register pair is compared against the central EVTIMER. When a match occurs, an interrupt request is generated if enabled. A separate pair of MATCH registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own local value at the same pair of addresses.
BitField.name: MATCH_VALUE

BitField.description: This bit is set when a match occurs between the central 64-bit EVTIMER and the value programmed in the Match-register pair for the associated CPU This bit is cleared by writing a '1'. Writes to clear this bit are asynchronous. This should be done before a new match value is written into the MATCH_L/H registers
BitField.name: OSTIMER_INTRFLAG

BitField.description: When this bit is '1' an interrupt/wakeup request to the Domainn processor will be asserted when the OSTIMER_INTR flag is set. When this bit is '0', interrupt/wakeup requests due to the OSTIMER_INTR flag are blocked.A separate OSEVENT_CTRL register is implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own local value at the same address.
BitField.name: OSTIMER_INTENA

BitField.description: This bit will be low when it is safe to write to reload the Match Registers. In typical applications it should not be necessary to test this bit.
BitField.name: MATCH_WR_RDY

BitField.description: CRC polynomial: 1X = CRC-32 polynomial 01 = CRC-16 polynomial 00 = CRC-CCITT polynomial
BitField.name: CRC_POLY

BitField.description: Data bit order: 1 = Bit order reverse for CRC_WR_DATA (per byte) 0 = No bit order reverse for CRC_WR_DATA (per byte)
BitField.name: BIT_RVS_WR

BitField.description: Data complement: 1 = 1's complement for CRC_WR_DATA 0 = No 1's complement for CRC_WR_DATA
BitField.name: CMPL_WR

BitField.description: CRC sum bit order: 1 = Bit order reverse for CRC_SUM 0 = No bit order reverse for CRC_SUM
BitField.name: BIT_RVS_SUM

BitField.description: CRC sum complement: 1 = 1's complement for CRC_SUM 0 = No 1's complement for CRC_SUM
BitField.name: CMPL_SUM

BitField.description: A write access to this register will load CRC seed value to CRC_SUM register with selected bit order and 1's complement pre-processes. A write access to this register will overrule the CRC calculation in progresses.
BitField.name: CRC_SEED

BitField.description: The most recent CRC sum can be read through this register with selected bit order and 1's complement post-processes.
BitField.name: CRC_SUM

BitField.description: Data written to this register will be taken to perform CRC calculation with selected bit order and 1's complement pre-process. Any write size 8, 16 or 32-bit are allowed and accept back-to-back transactions.
BitField.name: CRC_WR_DATA

BitField.description: Enable channel 0. When 1, PDM channel 0 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH0

BitField.description: Enable channel 1. When 1, PDM channel 1 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH1

BitField.description: Enable channel 2. When 1, PDM channel 2 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH2

BitField.description: Enable channel 3. When 1, PDM channel 3 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH3

BitField.description: Enable channel 4. When 1, PDM channel 4 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH4

BitField.description: Enable channel 5. When 1, PDM channel 5 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH5

BitField.description: Enable channel 6. When 1, PDM channel 6 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH6

BitField.description: Enable channel 7. When 1, PDM channel 7 is enabled.
BitField.name: EN_CH7

BitField.description: Choose which channels to sync to global sync (7:0) corresponds to the 8 channels
BitField.name: CH_SYNC_EN

BitField.description: 32bit value, global sync counter will trigger a pulse whenever count reaches GCOUNTVAL
BitField.name: CCOUNTVAL

Enum.description: assert reset to decimator Note : resets are applied in pairs. So bit 0 corresponds to channels 0/1, bit1 corresponds to channels 2/3, bit2 to channel 4/5 and bit3 to channel 6/7
Enum.name: ASSERT_RESET

BitField.description: Gain factor for input signal into HWVAD
BitField.name: INPUTGAIN

BitField.description: This field chooses the High Pass filter in first part of HWVAD
BitField.name: HPFS

Enum.description: High pass filter with -3dB cut-off at 1750Hz.
Enum.name: HIGH_PASS_1750HZ

Enum.description: High pass filter with -3dB cut-off at 215Hz.
Enum.name: HIGH_PASS_215HZ

BitField.description: 1' means enter stage 1 of VAD, ie a sound change has been detected and the HWVAD is being allowed to settle. Use 0 when changing back to detection mode. Allow several milliseconds in stage 1 for settling.
BitField.name: ST10

Enum.description: Normal operation, waiting for HWVAD trigger event (stage 0).
Enum.name: NORMAL

Enum.description: Reset internal interrupt flag by writing a '1' pulse.
Enum.name: RESET

BitField.description: Reset HWVAD. Write back to 0 to release reset.
BitField.name: RSTT

BitField.description: Gain Factor for Noise-floor - use a positive number to make average less sensitive to sudden changes
BitField.name: THGN

BitField.description: Signal Gain factor - use a postive number to make current signal stand out more over longer term average
BitField.name: THGS

BitField.description: Set to force re-loading the shadow registers (HW/SW capability and LOCK). This operation will automatically set OTP_STATUS.BUSY. Once the shadow registers have been re-loaded, OTP_STATUS.BUSY and RELOAD_SHADOWS are automatically cleared by the controller
BitField.name: RELOAD_SHADOWS

BitField.description: Set to start CRC calculation. This operation will automatically set OTP_STATUS.BUSY. Once CRC is calculation done, OTP_STATUS.BUSY and CRC_TEST are automatically cleared by the controller
BitField.name: CRC_TEST

BitField.description: Set to write-lock the fuse word when it's being programming. When programming with ECC mode, it recommends to set this bit.
BitField.name: WORDLOCK

BitField.description: Write 0x3E77 to enable OTP write accesses. NOTE: The write operation must be unlocked for each word by writing 0x3E77 to WR_UNLOCK field. Then writing to OTP_WRITE_DATA register will automatically start the programming procedure.
BitField.name: WR_UNLOCK

BitField.description: This bit indicates the PDN value of OTP memory. Writing 1 to the bit to clear PDN. Writing 0 has no effect. Note: Software need to write 1 to this bit to shut off power of OTP memory after system power up. At the beginning of every fuse operation, the controller will automatically turn-on power to the OPT memory. After every fuse operation, software also need to write 1 to this bit to shut off power to the OTP memory to reduce power consumption.
BitField.name: PDN

BitField.description: Fuse word programming data. After the write operation is unlocked in OTP_CTRL register, writing data to this register automatically start the programming procedure.
BitField.name: WRITE_DATA

BitField.description: Fuse word read data from read operation
BitField.name: READ_DATA

BitField.description: Clock divider value by -1 encoding. It's used to generate the clock to OTP memory (otp_clk) with apb_clk. The maximum otp_clk frequency is 120Mhz. 0: Divide by 1
BitField.name: DIV

BitField.description: Resets the divider counter. Can be used to make sure a new divider value is used right away rather than completing the previous count.
BitField.name: RESET

BitField.description: Halts the divider counter. The intent is to allow the divider's clock source to be changed without the risk of a glitch at the output.
BitField.name: HALT

BitField.description: Divider status flag. Set when a change is made to the divider value, cleared when the change is complete.
BitField.name: REQFLAG

BitField.description: Specify which of the 8 CRC reference value to use for CRC calculation. When the CRC result for the fuse data from CRC_START_ADDR to CRC_AND_ADDR and this CRC reference value is 0, the CRC check passes.
BitField.name: CRC_REF_ADDR

BitField.description: The CRC result value. When it is locked, reading from it returns value 32hBADA_BADA
BitField.name: CRC_VALUE

BitField.description: OTP Single Error Corrected status of ECC during read operation. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: SEC

BitField.description: OTP Double Error Detection status of ECC during read operation. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: DED

BitField.description: OTP LOCKED status during read/write operation. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: LOCKED

BitField.description: OTP PROGFAIL status. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: PROGFAIL

BitField.description: OTP Power OK status. Indicate that power VDD are in the operating range.
BitField.name: PWOK

BitField.description: OTP Single Error Corrected status of ECC during reload process. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: SEC_RELOAD

BitField.description: OTP Double Error Detect status of ECC during reload process. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: DED_RELOAD

BitField.description: OTP controller status bit. When active, no new write or read access to OTP (including RELOAD_SHADOWS) can be performed. Cleared by the controller when the access completes. After reset (or after setting RELOAD_SHADOWS), this bit is set by the controller and cleared after all the shadow registers are successfully loaded.
BitField.name: BUSY

BitField.description: Set by the controller when a read/write access to a locked region (OTP or shadow register) is requested. Writing 1 to clear it before any further access can be performed. This bit can only be set by the controller.
BitField.name: ERROR

BitField.description: CRC failed when set by hardware for CRC operation. Write 1 to clear.
BitField.name: CRC_FAIL

BitField.description: Indicate all shadows registers have been loaded with their corresponding fuse words when set by the controller after reset.
BitField.name: FUSE_LATCHED

BitField.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading
BitField.name: RXCLKSRC

Enum.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.
Enum.name: RXCLKSRC_0

Enum.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.
Enum.name: RXCLKSRC_1

Enum.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad
Enum.name: RXCLKSRC_3

BitField.description: The serial root clock could be divided inside FlexSPI wrapper. Refer Clocks chapter for more details on clocking.
BitField.name: SERCLKDIV

BitField.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.
BitField.name: HSEN

Enum.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.
Enum.name: HSEN_0

Enum.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.
Enum.name: HSEN_1

Enum.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.
Enum.name: DOZEEN_0

Enum.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.
Enum.name: DOZEEN_1

BitField.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL. If SCLK free-running is enabled, data sampling with loopback clock from SCLK pad is not supported (MCR0[RXCLKSRC]=2).
BitField.name: SCKFREERUNEN

BitField.description: This bit is used to enable/disable data learning feature. When data learning is disabled, the sampling clock phase 0 is always used for RX data sampling even if LEARN instruction is correctly executed.
BitField.name: LEARNEN

BitField.description: Time out wait cycle for IP command grant.
BitField.name: IPGRANTWAIT

BitField.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.
BitField.name: AHBGRANTWAIT

BitField.description: AHB Read/Write access to Serial Flash Memory space will timeout if not data received from Flash or data not transmitted after AHBBUSWAIT * 1024 ahb clock cycles, AHB Bus will get an error response
BitField.name: AHBBUSWAIT

BitField.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles
BitField.name: SEQWAIT

BitField.description: This bit determines whether AHB RX Buffer and AHB TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI returns STOP mode ACK. Software should set this bit if AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer will be powered off in STOP mode. Otherwise AHB read access after exiting STOP mode may hit AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer but their data entries are invalid.
BitField.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT

Enum.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.
Enum.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_0

Enum.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.
Enum.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_1

BitField.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.
BitField.name: CLRLEARNPHASE

BitField.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.
BitField.name: SAMEDEVICEEN

Enum.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. BitField.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.
BitField.name: SEQIDLE

BitField.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.
BitField.name: ARBIDLE

BitField.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

BitField.description: General sequencer and finite state machine status
BitField.name: ACTIVEFSM

Enum.description: All PMC finite state machines are idle. OK to set APPLYCFG to trigger the PMC state machines.
Enum.name: ACTIVEFSM_0

Enum.description: One or more PMC finite state machines are active, do not set APPLYCFG or write to any PDRUNCFG or CTRL register values that are used by the PMC state machines.
Enum.name: ACTIVEFSM_1

Enum.description: vddcore POR was not tripped since the last cleared.
Enum.name: PORCOREF_0

Enum.description: POR triggered by the vddcore POR monitor. Write 1 to clear
Enum.name: PORCOREF_1

Enum.description: No vdd1v8 power on event detected since last cleared.
Enum.name: POR1V8F_0

Enum.description: vdd1v8 power on detect caused a reset or deep pd wakeup. Write 1 to clear.
Enum.name: POR1V8F_1

Enum.description: No vdd_ao18 power on event detected since last cleared.
Enum.name: PORAO18F_0

Enum.description: vdd_ao18 power on detect caused a reset. Write 1 to clear.
Enum.name: PORAO18F_1

BitField.description: vddcore Low-Voltage Detector Flag This flag is set when a low voltage event was detected by the vddcore LVD monitor and it is enabled for interrupt or reset
BitField.name: LVDCOREF

Enum.description: vddcore LVD has not triggered an interrupt or reset since last clear
Enum.name: LVDCOREF_0

Enum.description: vddcore LVD triggered an interrupt or reset since last time this bit was cleared. Write 1 to clear
Enum.name: LVDCOREF_1

BitField.description: vddcore High-Voltage Detector Flag This flag is set when a high-voltage event was detected by the vddcore HVD monitor and it is enabled for interrupt or reset
BitField.name: HVDCOREF

Enum.description: vddcore HVD has not triggered an interrupt or reset since last clear
Enum.name: HVDCOREF_0

Enum.description: vddcore HVD triggered an interrupt or reset since last time this bit was cleared. Write 1 to clear
Enum.name: HVDCOREF_1

BitField.description: vdd1v8 High-Voltage Detector Flag This flag is set when a high-voltage event was detected by the vdd1v8 HVD monitor and it is enabled for interrupt or reset
BitField.name: HVD1V8F

Enum.description: vdd1v8 HVD has not triggered an interrupt or reset since last clear
Enum.name: HVD1V8F_0

Enum.description: vdd1v8 HVD triggered an interrupt or reset since last time this bit was cleared. Write 1 to clear
Enum.name: HVD1V8F_1

BitField.description: RTC Wakeup from deep powerdown mode flag.
BitField.name: RTCF

Enum.description: No RTC wakeup detected since last time flag was cleared.
Enum.name: RTCF_0

Enum.description: RTC wakeup caused a deep powerdown wakeup. Write 1 to clear.
Enum.name: RTCF_1

Enum.description: No PMC Auto Wakeup Interrupt detected since last time cleared.
Enum.name: AUTOWKF_0

Enum.description: PMC Auto wakeup caused a deep sleep wakeup and interrupt. Write 1 to clear.
Enum.name: AUTOWKF_1

Enum.description: No interrupt detected since flag last cleared.
Enum.name: INTNPADF_0

Enum.description: Pad interrupt caused a wakeup or interrupt event since the last time this flag was cleared. Write 1 to clear.
Enum.name: INTNPADF_1

Enum.description: No reset detected since last time this flag was cleared.
Enum.name: RESETNPADF_0

Enum.description: Reset pad wakeup caused a wakeup or reset event since the last time this bit was cleared. Write 1 to clear.
Enum.name: RESETNPADF_1

Enum.description: No deep powerdown wakeup since last time flag was cleared.
Enum.name: DEEPPDF_0

Enum.description: Deep powerdown was entered since the last time this flag was cleared. Write 1 to clear
Enum.name: DEEPPDF_1

Enum.description: Do not start the sequence. Writes of this value have no effect.

Register.name: INTPTD

BitField.description: This indicates the first PTD that is used by the hardware when it is processing the INT list.
BitField.name: INT_FIRST

BitField.description: Base address to be used by the hardware to find the start of the INT list.
BitField.name: INT_BASE

Register.description: Memory base address that indicates the start of the data payload buffers
Register.name: DATAPAYLOAD

BitField.description: Base address to be used by the hardware to find the start of the data payload section.
BitField.name: DAT_BASE

BitField.description: Host Controller Reset: This control bit is used by the software to reset the host controller.
BitField.name: HCRESET

BitField.description: Frame List Size: This field specifies the size of the frame list.
BitField.name: FLS

BitField.description: Light Host Controller Reset: This bit allows the driver software to reset the host controller without affecting the state of the ports.
BitField.name: LHCR

BitField.description: Port Change Detect: The host controller sets this bit to logic 1 when any port has a change bit transition from a 0 to a one or a Force Port Resume bit transition from a 0 to a 1 as a result of a J-K transition detected on a suspended port. or - the ID pin value changes or - an LPM token has been transmitted to enter LPM L1 suspend state.. Software must write a one to clear the bit
BitField.name: PCD

BitField.description: Frame List Rollover: The host controller sets this bit to logic 1 when the frame list index rolls over its maximum value to 0.
BitField.name: FLR

BitField.description: ATL IRQ: Indicates that an ATL PTD (with I-bit set) was completed.
BitField.name: ATL_IRQ

BitField.description: ISO IRQ: Indicates that an ISO PTD (with I-bit set) was completed.
BitField.name: ISO_IRQ

BitField.description: INT IRQ: Indicates that an INT PTD (with I-bit set) was completed.
BitField.name: INT_IRQ

BitField.description: SOF interrupt: Every time when the host sends a Start of Frame token on the USB bus, this bit is set.
BitField.name: SOF_IRQ

BitField.description: Port Change Detect Interrupt Enable: 1: enable 0: disable.
BitField.name: PCDE

BitField.description: Frame List Rollover Interrupt Enable: 1: enable 0: disable.
BitField.name: FLRE

BitField.description: ATL IRQ Enable bit: 1: enable 0: disable.
BitField.name: ATL_IRQ_E

BitField.description: ISO IRQ Enable bit: 1: enable 0: disable.
BitField.name: ISO_IRQ_E

BitField.description: INT IRQ Enable bit: 1: enable 0: disable.
BitField.name: INT_IRQ_E

BitField.description: SOF Interrupt Enable bit: 1: enable 0: disable.
BitField.name: SOF_E

BitField.description: Current Connect Status: Logic 1 indicates a device is present on the port.
BitField.name: CCS

BitField.description: Connect Status Change: Logic 1 means that the value of CCS has changed.
BitField.name: CSC

BitField.description: Port Enabled/Disabled Change: Logic 1 means that the value of PED has changed.
BitField.name: PEDC

BitField.description: Over-current active: Logic 1 means that this port has an over-current condition.
BitField.name: OCA

BitField.description: Over-current change: Logic 1 means that the value of OCA has changed.
BitField.name: OCC

BitField.description: Force Port Resume: Logic 1 means resume (K-state) detected or driven on the port.
BitField.name: FPR

BitField.description: Suspend: Logic 1 means port is in the suspend state.Logic 0 means the port is not suspended.
BitField.name: SUSP

BitField.description: Port Reset: Logic 1 means the port is in the reset state.
BitField.name: PR

BitField.description: Suspend using L1 0b = Suspend using L2 1b = Suspend using L1 When this bit is set to a 1 and a non-zero value is specified in the Device Address field, the host controller will generate an LPM Token to enter the L1 state whenever software writes a one to the Suspend bit, as well as L1 exit timing during any device or host-initiated resume.
BitField.name: SUS_L1

BitField.description: Line Status: This field reflects the current logical levels of the DP (bit 11) and DM (bit 10) signal lines.
BitField.name: LS

BitField.description: Port Power: The function of this bit depends on the value of the Port Power Control (PPC) bit in the HCSPARAMS register.
BitField.name: PP

BitField.description: Port Indicator Control : Writing to this field has no effect if the P_INDICATOR bit in the HCSPARAMS register is logic 0.
BitField.name: PIC

BitField.description: Port Test Control: A non-zero value indicates that the port is operating in the test mode as indicated by the value.
BitField.name: PTC

BitField.description: Port Speed: 00b: Low-speed 01b: Full-speed 10b: High-speed 11b: Reserved.
BitField.name: PSPD

BitField.description: Wake on overcurrent enable: Writing this bit to a one enables the port to be sensitive to overcurrent conditions as wake-up events.
BitField.name: WOO

BitField.description: These two bits are used by software to determine whether the most recent L1 suspend request was successful: 00b: Success-state transition was successful (ACK) 01b: Not Yet - Device was unable to enter the L1 state at this time (NYET) 10b: Not supported - Device does not support the L1 state (STALL) 11b: Timeout/Error - Device failed to respond or an error occurred.
BitField.name: SUS_STAT

Register.description: Done map for each ATL PTD
Register.name: ATLPTDD

BitField.description: The bit corresponding to a certain PTD will be set to logic 1 as soon as that PTD execution is completed.
BitField.name: ATL_DONE

Register.description: Skip map for each ATL PTD
Register.name: ATLPTDS

BitField.description: When a bit in the PTD Skip Map is set to logic 1, the corresponding PTD will be skipped, independent of the V bit setting.
BitField.name: ATL_SKIP

Register.description: Done map for each ISO PTD
Register.name: ISOPTDD

BitField.description: The bit corresponding to a certain PTD will be set to logic 1 as soon as that PTD execution is completed.
BitField.name: ISO_DONE

Register.description: Skip map for each ISO PTD
Register.name: ISOPTDS

BitField.description: The bit corresponding to a certain PTD will be set to logic 1 as soon as that PTD execution is completed.
BitField.name: ISO_SKIP

Register.description: Done map for each INT PTD
Register.name: INTPTDD

BitField.description: The bit corresponding to a certain PTD will be set to logic 1 as soon as that PTD execution is completed.
BitField.name: INT_DONE

Register.description: Skip map for each INT PTD
Register.name: INTPTDS

BitField.description: When a bit in the PTD Skip Map is set to logic 1, the corresponding PTD will be skipped, independent of the V bit setting.
BitField.name: INT_SKIP

Register.description: Marks the last PTD in the list for ISO, INT and ATL
Register.name: LASTPTD

BitField.description: If hardware has reached this PTD and the J bit is not set, it will go to PTD0 as the next PTD to be processed.
BitField.name: ATL_LAST

BitField.description: This indicates the last PTD in the ISO list.
BitField.name: ISO_LAST

BitField.description: This indicates the last PTD in the INT list.
BitField.name: INT_LAST

Register.description: Controls the port if it is attached to the host block or the device block
Register.name: PORTMODE

BitField.description: If this bit is set to one, the port will behave as a USB device. If this bit is set to zero, the port will be controlled by the USB host block.
BitField.name: DEV_ENABLE

Enum.description: The SCT operates as two 16-bit counters named COUNTER_L and COUNTER_H.
Enum.name: DUAL_COUNTER

Enum.description: The SCT operates as a unified 32-bit counter.
Enum.name: UNIFIED_COUNTER

Enum.description: System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the entire SCT module including the counter(s) and counter prescalers.
Enum.name: SYSTEM_CLOCK_MODE

Enum.description: Sampled System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the SCT module, but the counter and prescalers are only enabled to count when the designated edge is detected on the input selected by the CKSEL field. The minimum pulse width on the selected clock-gate input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the high-performance, sampled-clock mode.
Enum.name: SAMPLED_SYSTEM_CLOCK_MODE

Enum.description: SCT Input Clock Mode. The input/edge selected by the CKSEL field clocks the SCT module, including the counters and prescalers, after first being synchronized to the system clock. The minimum pulse width on the clock input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the low-power, sampled-clock mode.
Enum.name: SCT_INPUT_CLOCK_MODE

Enum.description: Asynchronous Mode. The entire SCT module is clocked directly by the input/edge selected by the CKSEL field. In this mode, the SCT outputs are switched synchronously to the SCT input clock - not the system clock. The input clock rate must be at least half the system clock rate and can be the same or faster than the system clock.
Enum.name: ASYNCHRONOUS_MODE

BitField.description: SCT clock select. The specific functionality of the designated input/edge is dependent on the CLKMODE bit selection in this register.
BitField.name: CKSEL

BitField.description: A 1 in this bit prevents the lower match registers from being reloaded from their respective reload registers. Setting this bit eliminates the need to write to the reload registers MATCHREL if the match values are fixed. Software can write to set or clear this bit at any time. This bit applies to both the higher and lower registers when the UNIFY bit is set.
BitField.name: NORELOAD_L

BitField.description: A 1 in this bit prevents the higher match registers from being reloaded from their respective reload registers. Setting this bit eliminates the need to write to the reload registers MATCHREL if the match values are fixed. Software can write to set or clear this bit at any time. This bit is not used when the UNIFY bit is set.
BitField.name: NORELOAD_H

BitField.description: Synchronization for input N (bit 9 = input 0, bit 10 = input 1,, bit 12 = input 3); all other bits are reserved. A 1 in one of these bits subjects the corresponding input to synchronization to the SCT clock, before it is used to create an event. If an input is known to already be synchronous to the SCT clock, this bit may be set to 0 for faster input response. (Note: The SCT clock is the system clock for CKMODEs 0-2. It is the selected, asynchronous SCT input clock for CKMODE3). Note that the INSYNC field only affects inputs used for event generation. It does not apply to the clock input specified in the CKSEL field.
BitField.name: INSYNC

BitField.description: A one in this bit causes a match on match register 0 to be treated as a de-facto LIMIT condition without the need to define an associated event. As with any LIMIT event, this automatic limit causes the counter to be cleared to zero in unidirectional mode or to change the direction of count in bi-directional mode. Software can write to set or clear this bit at any time. This bit applies to both the higher and lower registers when the UNIFY bit is set.
BitField.name: AUTOLIMIT_L

BitField.description: A one in this bit will cause a match on match register 0 to be treated as a de-facto LIMIT condition without the need to define an associated event. As with any LIMIT event, this automatic limit causes the counter to be cleared to zero in unidirectional mode or to change the direction of count in bi-directional mode. Software can write to set or clear this bit at any time. This bit is not used when the UNIFY bit is set.
BitField.name: AUTOLIMIT_H

BitField.description: This bit is 1 when the L or unified counter is counting down. Hardware sets this bit when the counter is counting up, counter limit occurs, and BIDIR = 1.Hardware clears this bit when the counter is counting down and a limit condition occurs or when the counter reaches 0.
BitField.name: DOWN_L

BitField.description: When this bit is 1 and HALT is 0, the L or unified counter does not run, but I/O events related to the counter can occur. If a designated start event occurs, this bit is cleared and counting resumes.
BitField.name: STOP_L

BitField.description: When this bit is 1, the L or unified counter does not run and no events can occur. A reset sets this bit. When the HALT_L bit is one, the STOP_L bit is cleared. It is possible to remove the halt condition while keeping the SCT in the stop condition (not running) with a single write to this register to simultaneously clear the HALT bit and set the STOP bit. Once set, only software can clear this bit to restore counter operation. This bit is set on reset.
BitField.name: HALT_L

BitField.description: Writing a 1 to this bit clears the L or unified counter. This bit always reads as 0.
BitField.name: CLRCTR_L

BitField.description: L or unified counter direction select
BitField.name: BIDIR_L

Enum.description: Up. The counter counts up to a limit condition, then is cleared to zero.
Enum.name: UP

Enum.description: Up-down. The counter counts up to a limit, then counts down to a limit condition or to 0.
Enum.name: UP_DOWN

BitField.description: Specifies the factor by which the SCT clock is prescaled to produce the L or unified counter clock. The counter clock is clocked at the rate of the SCT clock divided by PRE_L+1. Clear the counter (by writing a 1 to the CLRCTR bit) whenever changing the PRE value.
BitField.name: PRE_L

BitField.description: This bit is 1 when the H counter is counting down. Hardware sets this bit when the counter is counting, a counter limit condition occurs, and BIDIR is 1. Hardware clears this bit when the counter is counting down and a limit condition occurs or when the counter reaches 0.
BitField.name: DOWN_H

BitField.description: When this bit is 1 and HALT is 0, the H counter does not, run but I/O events related to the counter can occur. If such an event matches the mask in the Start register, this bit is cleared and counting resumes.
BitField.name: STOP_H

BitField.description: When this bit is 1, the H counter does not run and no events can occur. A reset sets this bit. When the HALT_H bit is one, the STOP_H bit is cleared. It is possible to remove the halt condition while keeping the SCT in the stop condition (not running) with a single write to this register to simultaneously clear the HALT bit and set the STOP bit. Once set, this bit can only be cleared by software to restore counter operation. This bit is set on reset.
BitField.name: HALT_H

BitField.description: Writing a 1 to this bit clears the H counter. This bit always reads as 0.
BitField.name: CLRCTR_H

Enum.description: The H counter counts up to its limit condition, then is cleared to zero.
Enum.name: UP

Enum.description: The H counter counts up to its limit, then counts down to a limit condition or to 0.
Enum.name: UP_DOWN

BitField.description: Specifies the factor by which the SCT clock is prescaled to produce the H counter clock. The counter clock is clocked at the rate of the SCT clock divided by PRELH+1. Clear the counter (by writing a 1 to the CLRCTR bit) whenever changing the PRE value.
BitField.name: PRE_H

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n is used as a counter limit for the L or unified counter (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: LIMMSK_L

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n is used as a counter limit for the H counter (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: LIMMSK_H

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n sets the HALT_L bit in the CTRL register (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: HALTMSK_L

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n sets the HALT_H bit in the CTRL register (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: HALTMSK_H

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n sets the STOP_L bit in the CTRL register (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: STOPMSK_L

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n sets the STOP_H bit in the CTRL register (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: STOPMSK_H

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n clears the STOP_L bit in the CTRL register (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: STARTMSK_L

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n clears the STOP_H bit in the CTRL register (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: STARTMSK_H

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, read or write the 16-bit L counter value. When UNIFY = 1, read or write the lower 16 bits of the 32-bit unified counter.
BitField.name: CTR_L

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, read or write the 16-bit H counter value. When UNIFY = 1, read or write the upper 16 bits of the 32-bit unified counter.
BitField.name: CTR_H

BitField.description: Each bit controls one match/capture register (register 0 = bit 0, register 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of match/captures in this SCT. 0 = register operates as match register. 1 = register operates as capture register.
BitField.name: REGMOD_L

BitField.description: Each bit controls one match/capture register (register 0 = bit 16, register 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of match/captures in this SCT. 0 = register operates as match registers. 1 = register operates as capture registers.
BitField.name: REGMOD_H

BitField.description: Writing a 1 to bit n forces the corresponding output HIGH. Writing a 0 forces the corresponding output LOW (output 0 = bit 0, output 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of outputs in this SCT.
BitField.name: OUT

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n triggers DMA request 0 (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: DEV_0

BitField.description: A 1 in this bit triggers DMA request 0 when it loads the MATCH_L/Unified registers from the RELOAD_L/Unified registers.
BitField.name: DRL0

BitField.description: This read-only bit indicates the state of DMA Request 0. Note that if the related DMA channel is enabled and properly set up, it is unlikely that software will see this flag, it will be cleared rapidly by the DMA service. The flag remaining set could point to an issue with DMA setup.
BitField.name: DRQ0

BitField.description: If bit n is one, event n triggers DMA request 1 (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: DEV_1

BitField.description: A 1 in this bit triggers DMA request 1 when it loads the Match L/Unified registers from the Reload L/Unified registers.
BitField.name: DRL1

BitField.description: This read-only bit indicates the state of DMA Request 1. Note that if the related DMA channel is enabled and properly set up, it is unlikely that software will see this flag, it will be cleared rapidly by the DMA service. The flag remaining set could point to an issue with DMA setup.
BitField.name: DRQ1

BitField.description: The SCT requests an interrupt when bit n of this register and the event flag register are both one (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: IEN

BitField.description: Bit n is one if event n has occurred since reset or a 1 was last written to this bit (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.
BitField.name: FLAG

BitField.description: The SCT requests an interrupt when bit n of this register and the SCT conflict flag register are both one (output 0 = bit 0, output 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of outputs in this SCT.
BitField.name: NCEN

BitField.description: Bit n is one if a no-change conflict event occurred on output n since reset or a 1 was last written to this bit (output 0 = bit 0, output 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of outputs in this SCT.
BitField.name: NCFLAG

BitField.description: The most recent bus error from this SCT involved writing CTR L/Unified, STATE L/Unified, MATCH L/Unified, or the Output register when the L/U counter was not halted. A word write to certain L and H registers can be half successful and half unsuccessful.
BitField.name: BUSERRL

BitField.description: The most recent bus error from this SCT involved writing CTR H, STATE H, MATCH H, or the Output register when the H counter was not halted.
BitField.name: BUSERRH

Register.description: SCT capture register of capture channel
Register.name: CAP0

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, read the 16-bit counter value at which this register was last captured. When UNIFY = 1, read the lower 16 bits of the 32-bit value at which this register was last captured.
BitField.name: CAPn_L

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, read the 16-bit counter value at which this register was last captured. When UNIFY = 1, read the upper 16 bits of the 32-bit value at which this register was last captured.
BitField.name: CAPn_H

Register.description: SCT match value register of match channels
Register.name: MATCH0

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, read or write the 16-bit value to be compared to the L counter. When UNIFY = 1, read or write the lower 16 bits of the 32-bit value to be compared to the unified counter.
BitField.name: MATCHn_L

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, read or write the 16-bit value to be compared to the H counter. When UNIFY = 1, read or write the upper 16 bits of the 32-bit value to be compared to the unified counter.
BitField.name: MATCHn_H

BitField.description: If bit m is one, event m causes the CAPn_L (UNIFY = 0) or the CAPn (UNIFY = 1) register to be loaded (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of match/captures in this SCT.
BitField.name: CAPCONn_L

BitField.description: If bit m is one, event m causes the CAPn_H (UNIFY = 0) register to be loaded (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of match/captures in this SCT.
BitField.name: CAPCONn_H

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, specifies the 16-bit value to be loaded into the MATCHn_L register. When UNIFY = 1, specifies the lower 16 bits of the 32-bit value to be loaded into the MATCHn register.
BitField.name: RELOADn_L

BitField.description: When UNIFY = 0, specifies the 16-bit to be loaded into the MATCHn_H register. When UNIFY = 1, specifies the upper 16 bits of the 32-bit value to be loaded into the MATCHn register.
BitField.name: RELOADn_H

BitField.description: If bit m is one, event n happens in state m of the counter selected by the HEVENT bit (n = event number, m = state number; state 0 = bit 0, state 1= bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of states in this SCT.
BitField.name: STATEMSKn

BitField.description: Selects the Match register associated with this event (if any). A match can occur only when the counter selected by the HEVENT bit is running.
BitField.name: MATCHSEL

BitField.description: Select L/H counter. Do not set this bit if UNIFY = 1.
BitField.name: HEVENT

Enum.description: Selects the L state and the L match register selected by MATCHSEL.
Enum.name: L_COUNTER

Enum.description: Selects the H state and the H match register selected by MATCHSEL.
Enum.name: H_COUNTER

Enum.description: Selects the inputs selected by IOSEL.
Enum.name: INPUT

Enum.description: Selects the outputs selected by IOSEL.
Enum.name: OUTPUT

BitField.description: Selects the input or output signal number associated with this event (if any). Do not select an input in this register if CKMODE is 1x. In this case the clock input is an implicit ingredient of every event.
BitField.name: IOSEL

BitField.description: Selects the I/O condition for event n. (The detection of edges on outputs lag the conditions that switch the outputs by one SCT clock). In order to guarantee proper edge/state detection, an input must have a minimum pulse width of at least one SCT clock period .
BitField.name: IOCOND

BitField.description: Selects how the specified match and I/O condition are used and combined.
BitField.name: COMBMODE

Enum.description: OR. The event occurs when either the specified match or I/O condition occurs.
Enum.name: OR

Enum.description: MATCH. Uses the specified match only.
Enum.name: MATCH

Enum.description: IO. Uses the specified I/O condition only.
Enum.name: IO

Enum.description: AND. The event occurs when the specified match and I/O condition occur simultaneously.
Enum.name: AND

BitField.description: This bit controls how the STATEV value modifies the state selected by HEVENT when this event is the highest-numbered event occurring for that state.
BitField.name: STATELD

Enum.description: STATEV value is added into STATE (the carry-out is ignored).
Enum.name: ADD

Enum.description: STATEV value is loaded into STATE.
Enum.name: LOAD

BitField.description: This value is loaded into or added to the state selected by HEVENT, depending on STATELD, when this event is the highest-numbered event occurring for that state. If STATELD and STATEV are both zero, there is no change to the STATE value.
BitField.name: STATEV

BitField.description: If this bit is one and the COMBMODE field specifies a match component to the triggering of this event, then a match is considered to be active whenever the counter value is GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO the value specified in the match register when counting up, LESS THEN OR EQUAL TO the match value when counting down. If this bit is zero, a match is only be active during the cycle when the counter is equal to the match value.
BitField.name: MATCHMEM

BitField.description: Direction qualifier for event generation. This field only applies when the counters are operating in BIDIR mode. If BIDIR = 0, the SCT ignores this field. Value 0x3 is reserved.
BitField.name: DIRECTION

Enum.description: Direction independent. This event is triggered regardless of the count direction.
Enum.name: DIRECTION_INDEPENDENT

Enum.description: Counting up. This event is triggered only during up-counting when BIDIR = 1.
Enum.name: COUNTING_UP

Enum.description: Counting down. This event is triggered only during down-counting when BIDIR = 1.
Enum.name: COUNTING_DOWN

Enum.name: OUTPUT

BitField.description: Selects the input or output signal number associated with this event (if any). Do not select an input in this register if CKMODE is 1x. In this case the clock input is an implicit ingredient of every event.
BitField.name: IOSEL

BitField.description: Selects the I/O condition for event n. (The detection of edges on outputs lag the conditions that switch the outputs by one SCT clock). In order to guarantee proper edge/state detection, an input must have a minimum pulse width of at least one SCT clock period .
BitField.name: IOCOND

BitField.description: Selects how the specified match and I/O condition are used and combined.
BitField.name: COMBMODE

Enum.description: OR. The event occurs when either the specified match or I/O condition occurs.
Enum.name: OR

Enum.description: MATCH. Uses the specified match only.
Enum.name: MATCH

Enum.description: IO. Uses the specified I/O condition only.
Enum.name: IO

Enum.description: AND. The event occurs when the specified match and I/O condition occur simultaneously.
Enum.name: AND

BitField.description: This bit controls how the STATEV value modifies the state selected by HEVENT when this event is the highest-numbered event occurring for that state.
BitField.name: STATELD

Enum.description: STATEV value is added into STATE (the carry-out is ignored).
Enum.name: ADD

Enum.description: STATEV value is loaded into STATE.
Enum.name: LOAD

BitField.description: This value is loaded into or added to the state selected by HEVENT, depending on STATELD, when this event is the highest-numbered event occurring for that state. If STATELD and STATEV are both zero, there is no change to the STATE value.
BitField.name: STATEV

BitField.description: If this bit is one and the COMBMODE field specifies a match component to the triggering of this event, then a match is considered to be active whenever the counter value is GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO the value specified in the match register when counting up, LESS THEN OR EQUAL TO the match value when counting down. If this bit is zero, a match is only be active during the cycle when the counter is equal to the match value.
BitField.name: MATCHMEM

BitField.description: Direction qualifier for event generation. This field only applies when the counters are operating in BIDIR mode. If BIDIR = 0, the SCT ignores this field. Value 0x3 is reserved.
BitField.name: DIRECTION

Enum.description: Direction independent. This event is triggered regardless of the count direction.
Enum.name: DIRECTION_INDEPENDENT

Enum.description: Counting up. This event is triggered only during up-counting when BIDIR = 1.
Enum.name: COUNTING_UP

Enum.description: Counting down. This event is triggered only during down-counting when BIDIR = 1.
Enum.name: COUNTING_DOWN

BitField.description: If bit m is one, event n happens in state m of the counter selected by the HEVENT bit (n = event number, m = state number; state 0 = bit 0, state 1= bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of states in this SCT.
BitField.name: STATEMSKn

BitField.description: Selects the Match register associated with this event (if any). A match can occur only when the counter selected by the HEVENT bit is running.
BitField.name: MATCHSEL

BitField.description: Select L/H counter. Do not set this bit if UNIFY = 1.
BitField.name: HEVENT

Enum.name: L_COUNTER

Enum.name: MATCH

Enum.description: IO. Uses the specified I/O condition only.
Enum.name: IO

Enum.description: AND. The event occurs when the specified match and I/O condition occur simultaneously.
Enum.name: AND

BitField.description: This bit controls how the STATEV value modifies the state selected by HEVENT when this event is the highest-numbered event occurring for that state.
BitField.name: STATELD

Enum.description: STATEV value is added into STATE (the carry-out is ignored).
Enum.name: ADD

Enum.description: STATEV value is loaded into STATE.
Enum.name: LOAD

BitField.description: This value is loaded into or added to the state selected by HEVENT, depending on STATELD, when this event is the highest-numbered event occurring for that state. If STATELD and STATEV are both zero, there is no change to the STATE value.
BitField.name: STATEV

BitField.description: If this bit is one and the COMBMODE field specifies a match component to the triggering of this event, then a match is considered to be active whenever the counter value is GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO the value specified in the match register when counting up, LESS THEN OR EQUAL TO the match value when counting down. If this bit is zero, a match is only be active during the cycle when the counter is equal to the match value.
BitField.name: MATCHMEM

BitField.description: Direction qualifier for event generation. This field only applies when the counters are operating in BIDIR mode. If BIDIR = 0, the SCT ignores this field. Value 0x3 is reserved.
BitField.name: DIRECTION

Enum.description: Direction independent. This event is triggered regardless of the count direction.
Enum.name: DIRECTION_INDEPENDENT

Enum.description: Counting up. This event is triggered only during up-counting when BIDIR = 1.
Enum.name: COUNTING_UP

Enum.description: Counting down. This event is triggered only during down-counting when BIDIR = 1.
Enum.name: COUNTING_DOWN

BitField.description: If bit m is one, event n happens in state m of the counter selected by the HEVENT bit (n = event number, m = state number; state 0 = bit 0, state 1= bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of states in this SCT.
BitField.name: STATEMSKn

BitField.description: Selects the Match register associated with this event (if any). A match can occur only when the counter selected by the HEVENT bit is running.
BitField.name: MATCHSEL

BitField.description: Select L/H counter. Do not set this bit if UNIFY = 1.
BitField.name: HEVENT

Enum.description: Selects the L state and the L match register selected by MATCHSEL.
Enum.name: L_COUNTER

Enum.description: Selects the H state and the H match register selected by MATCHSEL.
Enum.name: H_COUNTER

Enum.description: Selects the inputs selected by IOSEL.
Enum.name: INPUT

Enum.description: Selects the outputs selected by IOSEL.
Enum.name: OUTPUT

BitField.description: Selects the input or output signal number associated with this event (if any). Do not select an input in this register if CKMODE is 1x. In this case the clock input is an implicit ingredient of every event.
BitField.name: IOSEL

BitField.description: Selects the I/O condition for event n. (The detection of edges on outputs lag the conditions that switch the outputs by one SCT clock). In order to guarantee proper edge/state detection, an input must have a minimum pulse width of at least one SCT clock period .
BitField.name: IOCOND

BitField.description: Selects how the specified match and I/O condition are used and combined.
BitField.name: COMBMODE

BitField.description: A 1 in bit m selects event m to set output n (or clear it if SETCLRn = 0x1 or 0x2) output 0 = bit 0, output 1 = bit 1, etc. The number of bits = number of events in this SCT. When the counter is used in bi-directional mode, it is possible to reverse the action specified by the output set and clear registers when counting down, See the OUTPUTCTRL register.

Register.description: Contains the offsets of AB and CD in the RAM.

BitField.description: Which bank-pair the offset ABOFF is within. This must be 0 if only 2-up
BitField.name: ABBPAIR

BitField.description: Word or DWord Offset of AB values, with B at [2]=0 and A at [2]=1 as far as the code sees (normally will be an interleaved bank so only sequential to AHB). Word offset only allowed if 32 bit operation. Ideally not in the same RAM as the CD values if 4-up
BitField.name: ABOFF

BitField.description: Which bank-pair the offset CDOFF is within. This must be 0 if only 2-up
BitField.name: CDBPAIR

BitField.description: Word or DWord Offset of CD, with D at [2]=0 and C at [2]=1 as far as the code sees (normally will be an interleaved bank so only sequential to AHB). Word offset only allowed if 32 bit operation. Ideally not in the same RAM as the AB values
BitField.name: CDOFF

Register.description: Contains the opcode mode, iteration count, and result offset (in RAM) and also launches the accelerator. Note: with CP version: CTRL0 and CRTL1 can be written in one go with MCRR.
Register.name: CTRL1

BitField.description: Iteration counter. Is number_cycles - 1. write 0 means Does one cycle - does not iterate.
BitField.name: ITER

BitField.description: Operation mode to perform. write 0 means Accelerator is inactive. write others means accelerator is active.
BitField.name: MODE

BitField.description: Which bank-pair the offset RESOFF is within. This must be 0 if only 2-up. Ideally this is not the same bank as ABBPAIR (when 4-up supported)
BitField.name: RESBPAIR

BitField.description: Word or DWord Offset of result. Word offset only allowed if 32 bit operation. Ideally not in the same RAM as the AB and CD values
BitField.name: RESOFF

BitField.description: Skip rules on Carry if needed. This operation will be skipped based on Carry value (from previous operation) if not 0:

BitField.name: KEY

Enum.name: KWY_VALUE

Register.description: Control register to enable and operate Hash and Crypto
Register.name: CTRL

BitField.description: The operational mode to use, or 0 if none. Note that the CONFIG register will indicate if specific modes beyond SHA1 and SHA2-256 are available.
BitField.name: Mode

Enum.description: AES if available (see also CRYPTCFG register for more controls)
Enum.name: AES

Enum.description: ICB-AES if available (see also CRYPTCFG register for more controls)
Enum.name: ICB_AES

BitField.description: Written with 1 when starting a new Hash/Crypto. It self clears. Note that the WAITING Status bit will clear for a cycle during the initialization from New=1.
BitField.name: New_Hash

Enum.description: Starts a new Hash/Crypto and initializes the Digest/Result.
Enum.name: START

BitField.description: If 1, allows the SHA RELOAD registers to be used. This is used to save a partial Hash Digest (e.g. when need to run AES) and then reload it later for continuation.
BitField.name: RELOAD

Enum.description: Allow RELOAD registers to be used.
Enum.name: RELOAD

BitField.description: Written with 1 to use DMA to fill INDATA. If Hash, will request from DMA for 16 words and then will process the Hash. If Cryptographic, it will load as many words as needed, including key if not already loaded. It will then request again. Normal model is that the DMA interrupts the processor when its length expires. Note that if the processor will write the key and optionally IV, it should not enable this until it has done so. Otherwise, the DMA will be expected to load those for the 1st block (when needed).
BitField.name: DMA_I

Enum.description: DMA is not used. Processor writes the necessary words when WAITING is set (interrupts), unless AHB Master is used.
Enum.name: NOT_USED

Enum.description: DMA will push in the data.
Enum.name: PUSH

BitField.description: Written to 1 to use DMA to drain the digest/output. If both DMA_I and DMA_O are set, the DMA has to know to switch direction and the locations. This can be used for crypto uses.
BitField.name: DMA_O

Enum.description: DMA is not used. Processor reads the digest/output in response to DIGEST interrupt.
Enum.name: NOTUSED

BitField.description: If 1, will swap bytes in the word for SHA hashing. The default is byte order (so LSB is 1st byte) but this allows swapping to MSB is 1st such as is shown in SHS spec. For cryptographic swapping, see the CRYPTCFG register.
BitField.name: HASHSWPB

BitField.description: If 1, the block is waiting for more data to process.
BitField.name: WAITING

Enum.description: Not waiting for data - may be disabled or may be busy. Note that for cryptographic uses, this is not set if IsLast is set nor will it set until at least 1 word is read of the output.
Enum.name: NOT_WAITING

Enum.description: Waiting for data to be written in (16 words)
Enum.name: WAITING

BitField.description: For Hash, if 1 then a DIGEST is ready and waiting and there is no active next block already started. For Cryptographic uses, this will be set for each block processed, indicating OUTDATA (and OUTDATA2 if larger output) contains the next value to read out. This is cleared when any data is written, when New is written, for Cryptographic uses when the last word is read out, or when the block is disabled.
BitField.name: DIGEST

Enum.description: Digest is ready. Application may read it or may write more data
Enum.name: READY

BitField.description: If 1, an error occurred. For normal uses, this is due to an attempted overrun: INDATA was written when it was not appropriate. For Master cases, this is an AHB bus error; the COUNT field will indicate which block it was on.
BitField.name: ERROR

Enum.description: An error occurred since last cleared (written 1 to clear).
Enum.name: ERROR

BitField.description: Indicates the block wants the key to be written in (set along with WAITING)
BitField.name: NEEDKEY

Enum.description: No Key is needed and writes will not be treated as Key
Enum.name: NOT_NEED

Enum.description: Key is needed and INDATA/ALIAS will be accepted as Key. Will also set WAITING.
Enum.name: NEED

BitField.description: Indicates the block wants an IV/NONE to be written in (set along with WAITING)
BitField.name: NEEDIV

Enum.description: No IV/Nonce is needed, either because written already or because not needed.
Enum.name: NOT_NEED

Enum.description: IV/Nonce is needed and INDATA/ALIAS will be accepted as IV/Nonce. Will also set WAITING.
Enum.name: NEED

BitField.description: If ICB-AES is selected, then reads as the ICB index count based on ICBSTRM (from CRYPTCFG). That is, if 3 bits of ICBSTRM, then this will count from 0 to 7 and then back to 0. On 0, it has to compute the full ICB, quicker when not 0.
BitField.name: ICBIDX

Register.description: Write 1 to enable interrupts; reads back with which are set.
Register.name: INTENSET

BitField.description: Indicates if should interrupt when waiting for data input.
BitField.name: WAITING

BitField.description: Indicates if should interrupt when Digest (or Outdata) is ready (completed a hash/crypto or completed a full sequence).
BitField.name: DIGEST

Enum.description: Will not interrupt when Digest is ready
Enum.name: NO_INTERRUPT

Enum.description: Will interrupt when Digest is ready. Interrupt cleared by writing more data, starting a new Hash, or disabling (done).
Enum.name: INTERRUPT

BitField.description: Indicates if should interrupt on an ERROR (as defined in Status)
BitField.name: ERROR

Register.description: Setup Master to access memory (if available)
Register.name: MEMCTRL

Enum.description: Mastering is not used and the normal DMA or Interrupt based model is used with INDATA.
Enum.name: NOT_USED

Enum.description: Mastering is enabled and DMA and INDATA should not be used.
Enum.name: ENABLED

BitField.description: Number of 512-bit (128-bit if AES, except 1st block which may include key and IV) blocks to copy starting at MEMADDR. This register will decrement after each block is copied, ending in 0. For Hash, the DIGEST interrupt will occur when it reaches 0. Fro AES, the DIGEST/OUTDATA interrupt will occur on ever block. If a bus error occurs, it will stop with this field set to the block that failed. 0:Done - nothing to process. 1 to 2K: Number of 512-bit (or 128bit) blocks to hash.
BitField.name: COUNT

Register.description: Address to start memory access from (if available).
Register.name: MEMADDR

BitField.description: Address base to start copying from, word aligned (so bits 1:0 must be 0). This field will advance as it processes the words. If it fails with a bus error, the register will contain the failing word. N:Address in Flash or RAM space; RAM only as mapped in this part. May also be able to address SPIFI.
BitField.name: BASE

Register.description: Input of 16 words at a time to load up buffer.
Register.name: INDATA

BitField.description: Write next word in little-endian form. The hash requires big endian word data, but this block swaps the bytes automatically. That is, SHA assumes the data coming in is treated as bytes (e.g. "abcd") and since the ARM core will treat "abcd" as a word as 0x64636261, the block will swap the word to restore into big endian.

Enum.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE

Register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register
Register.name: AIRCR

BitField.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.
BitField.name: VECTCLRACTIVE

BitField.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.
BitField.name: SYSRESETREQ

Enum.description: Do not request a system reset.
Enum.name: NO_REQUEST

BitField.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.
BitField.name: SYSRESETREQS

Enum.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.
Enum.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE

Enum.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.
Enum.name: SECURE_ONLY

BitField.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states
BitField.name: PRIGROUP

BitField.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.
BitField.name: BFHFNMINS

Enum.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.
Enum.name: SECURE

Enum.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.
Enum.name: NON_SECURE

BitField.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.
BitField.name: PRIS

Enum.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical
Enum.name: SAME_PRIORITY

BitField.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.
BitField.name: ENDIANNESS

BitField.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.
BitField.name: VECTKEY

Register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.
Register.name: SCR

BitField.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.
BitField.name: SLEEPONEXIT

Enum.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.
Enum.name: NOT_SLEEP

Enum.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR
Enum.name: SLEEP

BitField.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.
BitField.name: SLEEPDEEP

BitField.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.
BitField.name: SLEEPDEEPS

Enum.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.
Enum.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE

Enum.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.
Enum.name: SECURE_ONLY

BitField.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.
BitField.name: SEVONPEND

Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.
Enum.name: EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS

Enum.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor
Enum.name: INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS

Register.name: SHCSR

Register.description: The MPU Type Register indicates how many regions the MPU support. Software can use it to determine if the processor implements an MPU.
Register.name: TYPE

BitField.description: Indicates support for separate instruction and data address maps. RAZ. Armv8-M only supports a unified MPU
BitField.name: SEPARATE

BitField.description: Number of regions supported by the MPU. If this field reads-as-zero the processor does not implement an MPU.
BitField.name: DREGION

BitField.description: Enables the operation of MPU during HardFault and NMI handlers
BitField.name: HFNMIENA

Enum.description: MPU is disabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.
Enum.name: DISABLE

Enum.description: The MPU is enabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.
Enum.name: ENABLE

Enum.description: Disables the default memory map. Any instruction or data access that does not access a defined region faults.
Enum.name: ENABLE

Enum.description: Enables the default memory map as a background region for privileged accesses.
Enum.name: DISABLE

BitField.description: Indicates the memory region accessed by MPU_RBAR and MPU_RASR.

BitField.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.
BitField.name: AP

BitField.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.
BitField.name: SH

BitField.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.
BitField.name: BASE

BitField.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.
BitField.name: ATTRINDX

BitField.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.
BitField.name: LIMIT
